_about: TUTORIAL ISLAND (owner 2026-10-28): the shared island every NEW survivor lands on after character creation, before owning a Tamed Island. Kind 'tutorial': permanent, never a sail route, never a home, never claimed. A prebuilt indestructible town at the landing (Tutorial.dress: the standard camp fire, bench and shed, the Adventurer's Guild, a market stall, a stone fire pit, a drying rack, herbs, berries and trees) and wild lands outside it (wild_zones). # ASSUMPTION: grassland climate, tier 15 materials band at level 1 everywhere; seed and zone rows are this build's own.
_size_note: Owner 2026-10-28: 4-5x the home island's land. # ASSUMPTION 4.5x: home 375 x 300 m -> 795 x 636 m (x2.12 per side); size_m 880 holds it with the home's coast margin;
_perf_note: # ASSUMPTION (perf, owner 2026-10-28): ground cover full within 120 m of the town, 6 % beyond; biome dressing at 30 %; terrain_res 241 (~3.7 m cells). Harvest nodes stay inside the scatter's 420-600 clamp.
_no_alphas_note: # ASSUMPTION (2026-10-28): the level-1 newcomer island rolls no alphas (Spawner reads island_def.no_alphas).
_town_safe_note: # ASSUMPTION (2026-10-28): no wild zone sits closer than town_safe_m to the town, so compsognathus packs stay in the wild lands and leave the town and the early gather orders alone (Tutorial._wild_zones clamps each row's dist). The compsognathus pair sits at 160 m and the single compys are spread (200/265/310 degrees, ~75-105 m apart on the ring) so the first hunt meets one compy, not two.
wild_zones_about: Wild lands outside the town (ZoneSpawner): each row is a group placed 'dist' m from the town at 'angle' degrees (nearest dry land), spawned only while the survivor is within wake_m. Weak animals by the town, harder ones further out. # ASSUMPTION: rows, distances and species mix (existing species only).
